13638182541.detail_text: Easy to Assemble The storage rack is easy to assemble, making it a convenient addition to any child's room or play area. Versatile Use This versatile storage solution is perfect for homes with babies, offering a safe and organized space for toys and other belongings. Sturdy Construction Constructed with durable materials, this storage rack ensures long-lasting use and stability, even with heavy toy loads. Multi-layer Design The children's toy storage rack features a multi-layer design, providing ample space to organize and store various toys and items. Child-Friendly With its non-toxic materials and rounded edges, this storage rack is safe for children to use, providing peace of mind for parents.

aiTexts: This QIAOLEXIONG Multi-layer Children’s Toy Storage Rack offers versatile storage for toys, books, and displays.
Made from durable plastic, it withstands daily use and active play.
Its compact, multi-layer design maximizes space, ideal for small rooms and apartments.
Multiple shelves and compartments enable easy organization and clutter-free living spaces.
No assembly required, providing a convenient and practical solution for nursery or playroom organization.

product.desc:
Easy to Assemble

The storage rack is easy to assemble, making it a convenient addition to any child's room or play area.

Versatile Use

This versatile storage solution is perfect for homes with babies, offering a safe and organized space for toys and other belongings.

Sturdy Construction

Constructed with durable materials, this storage rack ensures long-lasting use and stability, even with heavy toy loads.

Multi-layer Design

The children's toy storage rack features a multi-layer design, providing ample space to organize and store various toys and items.

Child-Friendly

With its non-toxic materials and rounded edges, this storage rack is safe for children to use, providing peace of mind for parents.

aiTexts: The LANJIAOLUO Cosmetic Storage Organizer Drawer features a sleek Japanese-style design with a pure color pattern that complements any decor.
Made from durable ABS plastic, it resists moisture, making it perfect for humid bathroom environments.
Its rectangular shape optimizes space usage, ideal for small bathrooms or restrooms.
The dust cover keeps cosmetics clean and fresh by protecting them from dust and dirt.
Adjustable and practical, it offers an elegant and functional solution for organizing makeup accessories.

product.desc:
Easy Access

The drawers provide easy access to your items, allowing you to quickly find what you need without cluttering your space.

Space-Saving Design

This lazy corner mirror cabinet storage box drawer is designed to save space, making it perfect for small bathrooms or dressing areas.

Durable Material

Made from high-quality materials, this storage box is durable and long-lasting, ensuring it can withstand daily use.

Versatile Use

Ideal for storing cosmetics, lipsticks, masks, and other toiletries, this organizer can be placed on a table or hung on a wall, offering flexibility in placement.

User-Friendly

The drawers glide smoothly, providing a user-friendly experience, and the clear labels help you keep track of your items.

Are you tired of messy rooms, weak shelves, shaking racks, or boards that bend after a few months?

This upgraded heavy-duty metal rack is designed for Singapore homes—stronger, thicker, and easier to install, giving you rock-solid storage instantly.

📌📌📌The size of the packaging box is not related to the actual size of the shelf (please consult customer service if you have any questions)📌📌📌

1️⃣ Upgraded Strength — TRUE 100KG/Layer Load-Bearing

Most racks on the market claim “heavy-duty” but bend easily.

This one uses thickened double-sided steel columns + reinforced crossbeams under every panel.

Even when fully loaded with water bottles, appliances, tools, or storage boxes, it stays stable with no shaking.

2️⃣ Screw-Free Fast Installation — Assemble in Minutes

No tools, no screws, no frustration.

Click-in buckle structure makes installation simple—like building blocks.

Perfect for anyone who wants quick setup without drilling or fixing parts.

3️⃣ Adjustable Layers — Fits Any Singapore Home Space

Each layer can be repositioned freely to fit tall items, small boxes, cleaning supplies, fans, printers, luggage, and more.

One rack works for bedrooms, storerooms, kitchens, offices, even HDB service yards.

product.desc:
🚀Heavy-Duty Metal Storage Rack | 100KG/Layer | Screw-Free Fast Assembly | SG Local Stock

Are you tired of messy rooms, weak shelves, shaking racks, or boards that bend after a few months?

This upgraded heavy-duty metal rack is designed for Singapore homes—stronger, thicker, and easier to install, giving you rock-solid storage instantly.

📌📌📌The size of the packaging box is not related to the actual size of the shelf (please consult customer service if you have any questions)📌📌📌

🔥 Why This Rack Is the Best Choice for Singapore Homes

1️⃣ Upgraded Strength — TRUE 100KG/Layer Load-Bearing

Most racks on the market claim “heavy-duty” but bend easily.

This one uses thickened double-sided steel columns + reinforced crossbeams under every panel.

Even when fully loaded with water bottles, appliances, tools, or storage boxes, it stays stable with no shaking.

2️⃣ Screw-Free Fast Installation — Assemble in Minutes

No tools, no screws, no frustration.

Click-in buckle structure makes installation simple—like building blocks.

Perfect for anyone who wants quick setup without drilling or fixing parts.

3️⃣ Adjustable Layers — Fits Any Singapore Home Space

Each layer can be repositioned freely to fit tall items, small boxes, cleaning supplies, fans, printers, luggage, and more.

One rack works for bedrooms, storerooms, kitchens, offices, even HDB service yards.

Durable Material

Space-Saving
